blurb: Guests rent boats on Lake Union and Lake Washington. They can add a licensed captain for an additional fee, who handles navigation and docking. Captains are hired and paid directly by guests, with a 2-hour minimum.
extraNote: $1,000 security authorization required before vessel release · Cancellation more than 30 days before departure: 100% refund; 14-30 days: 50% refund; fewer than 14 days: non-refundable · Captains set their own fee, typically $75/hr, $100/hr on holidays, paid directly to captain · Seattle Rent A Boat may refuse or cancel rentals for safety, maintenance, weather, or other operational reasons · Anchored at the front of the show on Lake Union
